name: checkout missing first name
precondition: standard_user is logged in, on the cart page (/cart.html), and cart has 1 item.
steps: Click the 'Checkout' button to proceed to checkout step one.
Leave First Name empty, enter 'Doe' in Last Name, and enter '12345' in Zip/Postal Code.
expected_results: After step 1, the URL path is /checkout-step-one.html.
After step 3, the URL path is still /checkout-step-one.html.
After step 3, an error message is visible.
After step 3, the error message text reads 'Error: First Name is required'.
